correctness.rationale: Starting from the actual Q generator on +,−,0, direct determinant expansion yields λ(λ+a+b)(λ+a+2h)=(λ+b)v²q²; the simple principal eigenvalue controls fixed-order cumulant growth by finite-state Feynman–Kac analyticity and its uniform spectral gap. Matching powers of s=v²q² gives neutrality ac=b(a+b), A=1/L, C2=0, C3=−1/(bL^4), C4=1/(b²L^5). Hence κ6/T=−720v^6/(bL^4) and κ8/T=40320v^8/(b²L^5), while Brownian diffusion changes only κ2. Stationarity makes instantaneous velocity ±v with probability p/2 and zero otherwise; its sixth cumulant is v^6p(1−15p+30p²), yielding the exact threshold and positive short-time sign. Continuity plus negative long-time sign gives existence, not uniqueness, of T*>0. Independent symbolic cubic and threshold identities passed; finite-time numerical zero is not used as a proof.
